020import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.QuickShopAPI;
021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.economy.EconomyProvider;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
023import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.operation.Operation;
024import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.operation.result.EconomyOperationResult;
025
026import java.math.BigDecimal;
027
028/**
029 * EconomyDepositOperation
030 *
031 * @author creatorfromhell
032 * @since 6.2.0.11
033 */
034public class EconomyWithdrawOperation implements Operation {
035
036  private final QUser account;
037  private final BigDecimal amount;
038  private final String world;
039  private final String currency;
040  private boolean commit = false;
041  private boolean rollback = false;
042
043  /**
044   * Constructor for creating an EconomyWithdrawOperation object.
045   *
046   * @param account  the QUser account from which the amount will be withdrawn
047   * @param amount   the BigDecimal amount to be withdrawn
048   * @param world    the name of the world in which the transaction is performed
049   * @param currency the currency type for the transaction
050   */
051  public EconomyWithdrawOperation(final QUser account, final BigDecimal amount, final String world, final String currency) {
052
053    this.account = account;
054    this.amount = amount;
055    this.world = world;
056    this.currency = currency;
057  }
058
059  /**
060   * Commit the operation
061   *
062   * @return true if successes
063   */
064  @Override
065  public EconomyOperationResult commit() {
066
067    final EconomyProvider provider = QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getEconomyManager().provider();
068    if(provider == null) {
069      return new EconomyOperationResult(false, BigDecimal.ZERO);
070    }
071
072    final boolean result = provider.withdraw(account, world, currency, amount);
073    if(result) {
074      this.commit = true;
075    }
076    return new EconomyOperationResult(result, ((result)? amount : BigDecimal.ZERO));
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Check if operation is committed
081   *
082   * @return true if committed
083   */
084  @Override
085  public boolean isCommitted() {
086
087    return this.commit;
088  }
089
090  /**
091   * Check if operation is rolled back
092   *
093   * @return true if rolled back
094   */
095  @Override
096  public boolean isRollback() {
097
098    return this.rollback;
099  }
100
101  /**
102   * Rollback the operation
103   *
104   * @return true if successes
105   */
106  @Override
107  public boolean rollback() {
108
109    final EconomyProvider provider = QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getEconomyManager().provider();
110    if(provider == null) {
111      return false;
112    }
113
114    final boolean result = provider.deposit(account, world, currency, amount);
115    if(result) {
116      rollback = true;
117    }
118    return result;
119  }
120}
